 "content": "from collections import deque


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The scaffold is the leftmost framed rectangle: full-color rows and
    # columns delimit it, while colored objects lie to its right.
    row_candidates = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0]
    col_candidates = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 0]
    bg = grid[row_candidates[0]][0]
    bars_r = [r for r in row_candidates if grid[r][0] == bg]
    bars_c = [c for c in col_candidates if all(grid[r][c] == bg for r in range(h))]
    top, bottom = min(bars_r), max(bars_r)
    left, right = min(bars_c), max(bars_c)
    out = [row[left:right + 1] for row in grid[top:bottom + 1]]

    # Gather colored object cells on the right into 4-connected components.
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(right + 1, w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y - 1, x), (y + 1, x), (y, x - 1), (y, x + 1)):
                    if (0 <= yy < h and right < xx < w and (yy, xx) not in seen
                            and grid[yy][xx] == color):
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        q.append((yy, xx))
            minr = min(y for y, x in cells)
            minc = min(x for y, x in cells)
            shape = frozenset((y - minr, x - minc) for y, x in cells)
            objects.append((color, shape))

    # Each pair of horizontal bars encloses a cavity. Match its zero-cell
    # pattern to an object shape and paint that shape into the scaffold.
    for a, b in zip(bars_r, bars_r[1:]):
        holes = [(r, c) for r in range(a + 1, b) for c in range(left, right + 1)
                 if out[r - top][c - left] == 0]
        if not holes:
            continue
        minr = min(r for r, c in holes)
        minc = min(c for r, c in holes)
        cavity = frozenset((r - minr, c - minc) for r, c in holes)
        for color, shape in objects:
            if shape == cavity:
                for r, c in holes:
                    out[r - top][c - left] = color
                break
    return out


if __name__ == '__main__':
    pass
